raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "coordinate"
      role subject "Lucian"
      role object ?x
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "live in"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Piatra Neamț"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
